# TPF Labs — CALIBER+

> TPF Labs is the autonomous field robotics division of TPFtechnology (EU). Its product, CALIBER+, is an autonomous selective harvesting robot for fresh-market blueberries. It is in pre-production: field prototype 2027, commercial launch 2028. Images on the site are design concepts.

Key facts:
- Picks two rows at once with four SCARA arms; AI vision selects ripe berries (>97% ripeness accuracy, target).
- Target picking rate 17 kg/h per unit, 0% crop loss (vs about 5% for over-the-row harvesters), 12–14 h daily autonomy.
- Soft silicone + vacuum gripper, under 2 N of force; chilled 60 L hopper; tracked chassis, 450 kg; 48 V LiFePO4 with 600 W solar roof.
- Pricing: Robot-as-a-Service from €26,000 per season (≈€1.9/kg vs ≈€2.4/kg manual picking). Purchase: Lite (4 arms) from €55,000, Flagship (6 arms) from €80,000.
- Pilot program for farms: 30/60/90 days in season 2027 (row survey, autonomous harvest on 1 ha, report and season contract).
- Contact: drublev77@gmail.com
